concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading resting-state fMRI + paired MER scores from the HCP Subjects Release with checksums. The plan's Tasks 0.1/0.2 download only the Verified Datasets URLs, which the plan itself states contain none of the required variables. No plan element satisfies FR-001; the spec's core data-acquisition requirement is unbacked. The spec (and its Verified Datasets block) is the root cause — route to clarified to either supply a genuinely verified source or revise FR-001's scope.

concerns.location: spec.md:FR-002 / plan.md FR/SC Coverage Map row 'FR-002'
concerns.text: FR-002 mandates fMRIPrep CPU-only preprocessing with motion correction and bandpass filtering. The coverage map entry is "Documented deviation (no raw fMRI obtainable)" — i.e., no task, contract, or phase implements it. An unimplemented MUST-level FR cannot be closed by a deviation note in the plan; the spec must be revised (or a data source supplied) so FR-002 is either backed or removed.

FR-003 requires extracting time series from the Schaefer 200 atlas and computing Pearson FC matrices. Task 1.1 only reconstructs matrices from pre-existing fc_upper_tri vectors; no plan element performs time-series extraction or Pearson correlation. This is a distinct FR silently absorbed into the FR-002 deviation without being listed in the coverage map as such — the map claims FR-003 is "Covered by Task 1.1", which is inaccurate.

concerns.location: spec.md:US-1 Independent Test / US-2 Acceptance Scenario 3
concerns.text: US-1's independent test (5-subject run producing valid matrices + MER scores) and US-2 scenario 3 (report N and distribution of behavioral scores) have no plan element; with the gate expected to fail, N=0 and no behavioral distribution is ever reported. Task 3.2 records N only inside run_summary.json. These spec-level testable outcomes are unbacked and should be resolved in the spec revision alongside FR-001/FR-002.

The Data-Gap Report, validation gate, and data_gap_report.schema.yaml are plan elements with no corresponding FR/SC in the spec — plan over-reach relative to the current spec. Once the spec is revised to reflect actual data availability, add an FR covering the validation gate / data-gap reporting so these elements are traceable.
